about: Stark World Engine asset library manifest. Every model is a glTF 2.0 binary (.glb) whose textures are separate image files referenced by relative URI (shared between models). Paths are relative to the folder that holds this file. Units: metres, +Y up, glTF forward (+Z).

fields.id: stable asset id (used in world.json objects as {"t":"asset","asset":id})
fields.name: display name
fields.category: tree, bush, grass, flower, rock, wall, roof, prop, character, ...
fields.file: path of the .glb / .hdr (prefab: none, see parts)
fields.scale: uniform scale to apply in a world (1 = file units are metres)
fields.pivot: bottom-center | center | origin: where the model origin sits
fields.pbr: material maps by role: albedo, normal, orm (R=AO,G=roughness,B=metal), roughness, metallic, ao, emissive
